verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs describe a per-chat tool approval mode set from the chat input. In the everyday 'auto' setting, nothing changes on disk and no command runs until the user approves, and pending approvals appear as tool cards with Allow / Deny buttons. That delivers the core of explicit approval for dangerous actions. Missing for 10: command allowlists, documentation of elevated/permissive modes chosen per action rather than per chat, independent or hands-on corroboration.
